title: Export Growth Is Not Resilient Development
summary: From gross exports through domestic value, ownership, wages, capacity, imports, dependency, diversification, technology, place, distribution and resilience.
map_question: What records are required before export growth is not resilient development can support a bounded fiscal or macroeconomic decision?
interpretation_boundary: Revenue capacity is not distributive justice. Expenditure authorization is not delivered public value. Deficit size is not fiscal sustainability. Sovereign borrowing is not productive public investment. Export growth is not resilient development. Aggregate stabilization is not democratic macroeconomic legitimacy.

what_this_map_supports: Separate revenue, budget, delivery, debt, fiscal-rule, trade, external-balance, supply-resilience and macroeconomic-coordination decisions.
Explicit authority, identities, incidence, cost, delivery, assets, liabilities, transmission, distribution, due process, uncertainty, challenge and review.
Public reasoning without taxpayer, beneficiary, creditor, worker, consumer, firm, community, jurisdiction or country scoring or ranking.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not assess tax, authorize a budget, award procurement, deliver a service, issue or restructure debt, impose a tariff, apply a sanction, decide a treaty claim, or coordinate policy.
It does not convert revenue, spending, deficits, borrowing, exports or aggregate stabilization into outcomes.
It does not create a receipt, score, rank, stage advance or operating-outcome change.
